Kenji: uploaded quick artifact for the quant-sweep across GPUs/regions: https://redwood.corp/drive/bench/quant_sweep_1769123456.zip

Kenji: TL;DR: FP8 on H100 gives ~1.6x p50 speedup vs FP16 for seq=1024, INT8 on A100 with fused_gemm_int8_v2 yields ~1.8x throughput but shows measurable quality drop for long-instruction prompts on model-x-13b. T4 INT8 is unstable for >1k tokens.

Maya: thanks — did you keep batch=1? any kernel variants tested?

Kenji: batch=1 for latency; also ran batch=4 for peak throughput. Kernel set: H100: {triton_h100_fp8_v3, cublaslt_fp16}, A100: {fused_gemm_int8_v2, cublaslt_bf16}, T4: {triton_t4_int8}. Also tried kv strategies: `kv_chunk=128` and `kv_prefetch=true`.

Oliver: paste the condensed table (p50/p90/delta-ll) pls (seq=1024, batch=1).

Kenji: compact summary below (per-request latencies ms, throughput = tokens/s, delta_ll = avg per-token logprob vs BF16 baseline on A100 and vs FP16 baseline on H100/T4).

```
GPU   precision  p50  p90  tok_s  delta_ll
H100  FP16       180  260  1950   0.000
H100  FP8        112  170  3120  -0.004
A100  BF16       210  290  1700   0.000
A100  INT8       118  200  3040  -0.015
T4    FP16       420  610   700   0.000
T4    INT8       360  520   980   -0.065
```

Kenji: QA eval (2k prompts, SQuAD-like): FP8 on H100 dropped exact-match by 0.5% absolute (outside noise), A100 INT8 dropped 1.6% absolute on long-form (~>800 tokens) cases. Bootstrapped CIs available in artifacts.

Sabrina: region differences? we need to know cost+availability impact if we recommend H100 FP8 for Dedicated pools.

Kenji: us-east-1 vs eu-west-1: perf nearly identical (2-6ms p50 variance). Big difference is H100 capacity in eu-west-1 - sometimes unavailable, fallback to A100 leads to ~25% higher cost for same SLO if using BF16 baseline. We'll draft cost sim.

Jess: did kv prefetch or chunking affect quality? any evicitions or mem pressure?

Kenji: `kv_prefetch=true` reduces p50 by ~10% on H100/FP8 with no quality shift. `kv_chunk=128` helps memory footprint for long seq and avoided OOMs on T4. No evictions observed for seq<=2048 on H100/A100.

Maya: do we have flamegraphs/traces for fused_gemm_int8_v2? want to vet kernel bottleneck vs mem-copy overhead.

ml-bench-bot: artifacts uploaded -> /benchmarks/1769123456/artifacts.tar.gz (CSV perf, flamegraphs, traces, eval outputs).

Oliver: next steps I propose: 1) run 10k prompt FP8 eval on H100 at seq=1024 to tighten CI; 2) run mixed-precision policy test (FP8 primary, BF16 fallback) for 24h in staging; 3) reproduce fused_gemm_int8_v2 on driver+cuda_patch_r45 to validate kernel determinism; 4) cost sim for Dedicated H100 vs A100 with observed speedups.

Sabrina: tagging infra: @infra-bot can we reserve 4 H100 nodes in eu-west-1 for a 12h window tomorrow morning?

infra-bot: reservation requested: id res-20260321-14 — will confirm by 08:00 UTC tomorrow.

Kenji: I'll kick off the 10k FP8 run once reservation confirmed. Eval flags for reproducibility pasted below:

```
./bench/run.sh \
  --model model-x-13b \
  --precision fp8 \
  --kernel triton_h100_fp8_v3 \
  --seq-len 1024 \
  --batch 1 \
  --kv-prefetch true \
  --eval-set squadsampled_2k \
  --out results/fp8_h100_seq1024.csv
```

Jess: +1 to mixed-precision staging run. Also want a small guardrail: auto-fallback if delta_ll < -0.02 for a moving window of 500 prompts.

Kenji: noted. I'll add the fallback experiment and the alert. Adding summary to PR: https://redwood.corp/pull/6312

Maya: great work. small ask: please include the random seed and commit hash in the artifact metadata so we can reproduce exactly.

Kenji: will do, thanks.
